span.p:
Not possible in AKS: a disk key per node pool or per AKSNodeClass
→ one OS-disk key per cluster, application data separated per zone
Rotation: new key version every 12 months, no expiry dates
KMS: pipeline updates key version + re-writes Secrets, dev → acc → prd
